text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. Today's training was over.
We had talked before about monitoring her recovery step by step
during this camp, but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A light that almost blinds the eyes... Heh.
Is the sun vying with the great sea over
who can shower more love upon the frolicking mortals?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, the heavy arrow of love
will be aimed at us.
As for whose it is...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh, the hour of judgment... is still ahead, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness, she seems to be in peak condition today as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that is purely a matter of the heart.
Naturally, now that I have decided to take that step again,
I will not hesitate."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—However, a lingering anxiety remains.
We cannot afford any mishaps.
I must take care not to let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Gimlet-senpai!
Sorry to keep you waiting!
I've gathered the crew!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Brian-san!
Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
Will this really count as training?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Have you arrived, unbreakable ones?
Then let the curtain rise!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Creation of sand—
Now, let the throne of the new world be set here!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watch nervously to see what's about to unfold.
If she pushes herself too hard just because she's in top form,
everything we've built up to this point will go down the drain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having reached this point, while I believe
that Tanino Gimlet would never do such a thing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even with no doubts or hesitations, at any random moment, memories of that time come rushing back—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What are you
gonna make, Trainer?
I'm really having trouble deciding right now!
choice_data_list: Huh, should I make it? Or not?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you haven't heard?
It's a sand sculpture! A sand sculpture!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a contest to see who can make
the strongest and most beautiful thing
out of fragile sand!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Basically, we make something we think is strong...
So I was thinking of making a motorcycle!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll build one that's super tough and cool enough that it won't break even if you ride it!
...Wait, I don't have time to take it easy!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I thought she might be pushing herself too hard,
but it seems it wasn't training after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even during summer training camp, taking a breather is necessary.
I let out a sigh of relief, knowing there was nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we were already doing this, I decided to ask
Mayano Top Gun and Narita Brian what they wanted to make as well.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Umm, Maya is gonna make a super fast and super cool airplane! The pilot will be Papa, of course♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What about Brian-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I was dragged here against my will under the guise of 'special training.'
If there's no running, I'm not participating.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But still,
you're happy you got better, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Brian-san shares a room with Gimlet-san, so...
Maya kinda understands too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
When my roommate is struggling,
I just can't find anything to say, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That kind of stuff is hard.
Maya isn't that girl, after all.
Studying is waaaay easier!
choice_data_list: So you were looking out for me...
So you were worried about me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just your wild imagination, surely.
—More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "Maybe the one who's worried right now isn't us... but him."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. So Trainer, make a cool one to put them at ease! Come on, chop-chop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Put that one at ease" "reassure her"
—Does that mean Tanino Gimlet
is harboring anxiety of her own?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after resolving to protect them,
was I about to overlook it yet again?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she has worries, it's a Trainer's job to clear them away...!
I'll convey that to Tanino Gimlet through this sculpture crafting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet said she's "fine"...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've made up my mind, what should I make...?
When told it should be strong and cool,
the only one that comes to mind is Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, making Tanino Gimlet as-is is a bit... I'd rather give it a title that captures her image—
choice_data_list: "A Cocktail Glass to Intoxicate Even the Strongest"
'The Lime Flower That Never Burns Out'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making a cocktail glass that looks like it would shatter at a glance
completely unbreakable—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "May this reach them..." Praying with every touch, I carefully packed the sand, sculpting the very strength of Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...So this is a Trainer's strength and beauty.
Heh, I see."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Delicate, yet standing there
as if it were a stalwart knight...
choice_data_list: I tried to make it inspired by Gimlet, but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ho? ...And then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet's aesthetic intoxicates and captivates others. That strength, that conviction is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lime—its juice makes its presence known even when mixed with others. It roars, screams, laughs at surrender, and stands unwavering, declaring that it is here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "May this reach them..." Praying with every touch, I carefully packed the sand, sculpting the very willpower of Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...So this is a Trainer's strength and beauty.
Heh, I see."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "Clad in eternal flames, continuing to bloom, is it? Even resignation itself would run away from that."
choice_data_list: I tried to make it inspired by Gimlet, but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ho? ...And then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet intoxicates those around him,
all while burning his very existence into their memories.
There is no fear here—only...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Then, how about this?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
You are now what one might call
my—and my other self's—partner in crime.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What lurks within that chest of yours?
Vines of fear clinging from the abyss are nothing but dust before the raging hellfire that is me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet's smile brought me to my senses.
The one harboring anxiety
wasn't Tanino Gimlet, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I firmly press a hand against my chest and look back at Tanino Gimlet.
—As if to reassure him that I'm alright now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This which you brought to life... this right here!!
Is who I am, and the very essence of your being!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Look at me! Intoxicate yourselves with me!!
For the place we must head towards is our very demise!"
